patch.summary: Gusto cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Gusto pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Gusto cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Gusto against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (applicant tracking, time and attendance, HRIS integrations) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when US small businesses running payroll (and benefits) for the first time requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus
Side-by-side cost with Rippling on the same seat count

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: People/HRIS depth is light versus BambooHR; Gusto is payroll-first

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Time, performance, next-day pay, and many benefits tools are add-ons

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: US-centric; not a global EOR (Deel) or enterprise HCM

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Gusto on identical constraints.
